_comment: Everything the Apify PLATFORM owns rather than the build: pay-per-event prices,
store SEO, and public visibility. These cannot live in actor.json (it has no
pricing or SEO keys), and clicking them into the Console by hand is not
reproducible — so they are versioned here and applied with:
which PUTs them to /v2/acts/<actorId>. Event names MUST stay in sync with the
title: TikTok Growth Monitor
description: Track a batch of TikTok profiles over time: follower and view growth deltas, new videos, and viral-outlier alerts, with a webhook summary.
seoTitle: TikTok Growth Monitor - Track Followers, Views & Outliers
seoDescription: Monitor any batch of TikTok profiles on a schedule. Daily snapshots, follower and view growth deltas, new-video and viral-outlier alerts via webhook.

profile-monitored.eventDescription: Charged once per profile per run, only when a growth report is actually produced for it. Profiles the base scraper returns no data for are never charged. This is the analytics layer only — the base TikTok scraper bills you separately at its own price.

outlier-alert.eventDescription: Free ($0.00). Emitted once per video that crosses your viral-outlier threshold, so outlier volume is visible in the run's event breakdown.
